$themes.name: Catalogue
$themes.$description: The product catalogue: products.fourthwall.com's own DS (--color-*/--bg-*/--text-*/--font-*/--space-*/--radius-*/--motion-*) in its light-dark() light branch — the only catalogue surface visitors paint.

$themes.name: Catalogue dark
$themes.$description: The catalogue DS's declared dark branch: the same semantic names resolve through light-dark() under a dark color-scheme (--bg-primary #161712). Declared but never painted signed out — the catalogue ships no theme toggle, so these are forced-probe resolutions, not an observed public theme (docsDark and helpDark are the genuinely toggled themes).

Nothing was typed or submitted.
